description: Open Stripe Checkout for one $9.99 report. Returns a hosted checkout URL the human customer must open and pay. The agent must not pay and must not send card data. Email is optional. A checkout with no email is never reused. When a checkout is reused, the report token is not returned. After the customer pays, poll get_report.

email.description: Optional. Stripe Checkout collects an email when this is omitted. A checkout with no email is never reused.

source.description: Optional agent name stored with the order. Sanitized and length-capped.

vin.description: 17-character VIN. The check digit is required.

name: create_report_checkout
title: Start checkout for the customer
